reasoning: Upheld. One observation for the coordinator, which is not a defect under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments): the claim says the Rubber Act of 1948 is not held in the packet, which is true of the packet pins. The repository does hold it, at jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_9942_Rubber_Act_of_1948_..._87e4aa0ec5.txt (committed 2026-11-02). Section 20 reads 'This Act shall become effective on April 1, 1948, and shall remain in effect until June 30,1950.' EO 10539 of 1954 still acts under 'the Rubber Act of 1948 (62 Stat. 101), as amended' and amends this order, so the Act was extended. A statute that does not name the order does not end it, so EO 12553 remains the end. The disclosed candidate should cite that source when the claim is next revised.
